name: When is the best time to consider whole home accessibility upgrades?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to consider whole home accessibility upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to consider whole home accessibility upgrades is often before mobility challenges become critical. Proactive planning allows for thoughtful design choices and less disruptive renovations. It's also beneficial to consider these upgrades if you are planning to age in place, have a family member with current or anticipated mobility needs, or are experiencing minor difficulties navigating your home. Early planning can prevent future accidents and enhance long-term comfort.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider upgrades proactively before critical mobility challenges arise, especially if you plan to age in place or have family with anticipated needs. Early planning enhances safety and comfort.
